rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the oak tree itself.

example.english: The oak in the park has grown very tall.
example.traditional: 公園入面嗰棵橡樹生得好高。
example.jyutping: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 go2 fo2 zoeng6 syu6 sang1 dak1 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this for wood or timber obtained from an oak tree, rather than the living tree.

example.english: Our dining table is made of oak.
example.traditional: 我哋張餐枱係用橡木整嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 caan1 toi2 hai6 jung6 zoeng6 muk6 zing2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the rich brown colour associated with oak wood.

example.english: I want to paint the wall an oak color.
example.traditional: 我想將道牆油做橡木色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 dou6 coeng4 jau4 zou6 zoeng6 muk6 sik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for poison oak, the toxic plant, not an ordinary oak tree.

example.english: They touched poison oak while hiking, and their hand immediately turned red.
example.traditional: 佢行山掂到毒橡樹，隻手即刻紅晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haang4 saan1 dim3 dou2 duk6 zoeng6 syu6 zek3 sau2 zik1 hak1 hung4 saai3
